latest_release.name: v0.1.32
latest_release.body:
Branded query filter in GSC Insights, Local SEO in miles, and agent reports that lead with the plan.

## What's new

- Filter GSC Insights and the `get_search_console_performance` MCP tool by branded and non-branded queries
  - Google only classifies top-level properties with enough traffic; the filter is hidden on others
- Show Local SEO distances in miles
  - Switch units under Distances in Settings
- Reports from OpenSEO skills now open with a verdict and a short action plan
  - Update your OpenSEO skills to get it
- Use a treg token (`TREG_API_TOKEN`) instead of a DataForSEO key on Every App
  - Requires Every App Gateway 0.4.2 or later

## Fixed

- Site audits that a site blocks on every page, as many Shopify stores do, now show as Blocked instead of Done.
- Update keyword stats no longer fails on some older city rank trackers created by agents.
- Move to Every App now works from the standalone Docker setup.

Full Changelog: https://github.com/every-app/open-seo/compare/v0.1.31...v0.1.32

detail.readme: # OpenSEO > Open source alternative to Semrush and Ahrefs OpenSEO is an SEO tool for _the people_. If tools like Semrush or Ahrefs are too expensive or bloated, OpenSEO is a pay-as-you-go alternative that you actually control. > All-in-one SEO tool for you and your AI agent. Connect with any agent like Claude Code, OpenClaw or Hermes. We have pre-built skills, but you can build your own to tailor OpenSEO to your needs. ## Hosted Version Try OpenSEO for free on our website. If you want to support the project, a hosted subscription is $10/month. [openseo.so](https://openseo.so) ## Why use OpenSEO? - Best in class MCP and AI Skills. - Modern, simple UI. - Focused workflows instead of a bloated, complex SEO suite. - No subscriptions. - Bring your own DataForSEO API key and pay only for what you use. - Fork and vibe code your own custom tool. ## Main SEO Workflows - Keyword research - Rank tracking - Competitor Insights - Backlinks - Site Audits - AI Visibility ## OpenSEO MCP & Agent Skills OpenSEO exposes an MCP server so AI agents like Claude Code, OpenClaw, and Hermes can use your SEO data directly. Agent Skills are reusable workflows that guide your agent through SEO tasks using the MCP. - [Set up ChatGPT web or desktop](https://openseo.so/docs/chatgpt) (works on Free and paid ChatGPT plans) - [Set up Codex](https://openseo.so/docs/codex-plugin) - [Set up OpenSEO MCP](https://openseo.so/docs/mcp) - [Set up OpenSEO Agent Skills](https://openseo.so/docs/skills/setup) ## Self-Hosting ### Recommended: EveryApp EveryApp simplifies self hosting open source apps + personal software. It runs entirely in your Cloudflare account on their $5/month plan. It's also the company behind OpenSEO. OpenSEO actually started out because I was trying to do SEO for EveryApp. But, then people loved it so much that we paused EveryApp for a while. We've since relaunched it and think it's the best way to self host OpenSEO. https://everyapp.com/docs/apps/openseo ```bash npm install -g everyapp everyapp setup --domain apps.yourcompany.com everyapp install https://github.com/every-app/open-seo ``` ### DataForSEO API Key You need a DataForSEO API key to get SEO data, or a [treg](https://treg.to) account which also gives access to DataForSEO. See [`docs/DATAFORSEO_API_KEY.md`](./docs/DATAFORSEO_API_KEY.md). ### Other options OpenSEO also supports two standalone self-hosting paths. Both use email and password accounts: the first visitor creates the admin account, teammates join from invitation links, and MCP clients (Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, Cursor) sign in with the same accounts. - **Docker** - On your own server or computer, with a prebuilt image that is ready in seconds. Works with Compose-based platforms such as Coolify, Portainer and Dokploy. See [`docs/SELF_HOSTING_DOCKER.md`](./docs/SELF_HOSTING_DOCKER.md). - Running the older single-container image? It keeps getting updates; [move to the new setup](./docs/SELF_HOSTING_DOCKER.md#move-from-the-old-docker-image) when you are ready, data included. - **Cloudflare** - Self host on Cloudflare, but not with EveryApp. See [`docs/SELF_HOSTING_CLOUDFLARE.md`](./docs/SELF_HOSTING_CLOUDFLARE.md). For security-conscious setups, two advanced options replace the accounts with your own network controls: - **Cloudflare Access** in front of the Cloudflare deploy, so Cloudflare checks every request before it reaches OpenSEO. See [`docs/SELF_HOSTING_CLOUDFLARE.md`](./docs/SELF_HOSTING_CLOUDFLARE.md). - **No sign-in on Docker**, behind Tailscale, a private network or your own authenticating proxy. See [Without sign-in](./docs/SELF_HOSTING_DOCKER.md#without-sign-in-advanced). ## Costs OpenSEO needs a [DataForSEO](https://dataforseo.com/?aff=255379) API key so that you can get SEO data. You pay them directly when self hosting. See [openseo.so/pricing](https://openseo.so/pricing) When you self host, your costs will be slightly lower than the estimates on our website. The way the hosted service makes money is by charging 28% extra for every request we make to DataForSEO. ## Local Development See [`docs/LOCAL_DEVELOPMENT.md`](./docs/LOCAL_DEVELOPMENT.md). ## Contributing Creating clear issues is the best way to contribute. Read more here: [`.github/CONTRIBUTING.md`](./.github/CONTRIBUTING.md) We have this skill: `/simple-issue-description` which helps. ```sh npx skills add every-app/open-seo --skill simple-issue-description ``` ## Community Join Discord to chat: [Discord](https://discord.gg/c9uGs3cFXr) Follow along for updates: - Follow on X: https://x.com/bensenescu - Sign up for the mailing list on our website: [openseo.so](https://openseo.so)
